test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 24 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**From among the words given in bold, select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence.**

Small drops __**trickled**__ down the red and yellow __**tassels**__ of **__cannopies__** and **__dampened__ **the heads of little boys.
solution:
The correct answer is **'cannopies'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling would be **'canopies'.**
 
• **Canopy**__**: ** **A cover that hangs or spreads above something (चँदवा, छत्र, वितान)**
 __
 
• **​E.g.__**- The highest branches in the rainforest form a dense **canopy.**
 
 

**​**Hence, the correct answer is **'option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Tassels**__**: A group of short threads or ropes held together at one end, used as a hanging decoration on hats, curtains, furniture, etc.**
 
• __**Dampened**__**: to make something slightly wet**
 
• __**Trickle**__**: To go somewhere slowly and gradually.**
